creator.harness_identity_limit: Previously resolved conversation harness context; no current external actor-ID authentication or session-title role proof claimed

clock_basis: Python timezone-aware system UTC at record preparation; not original decision or filesystem publication time

last_confirmed_boundary: Completed bounded continuation independently freshly read back after report/result/evidence publication
observation_basis: Separate fresh-readback command; observation clock not exact publication time
repository_effects: Own authorized records only; endpoint checks PASS; no sandbox or continuous-event guarantee
pending_gate_references: Separate fresh Requirement Analysis start, or separately requested Orchestrator initiation with its Process Initiation interlock
Affected future runtime/live integration/release permissions, approved thresholds, evidence and approvals
blockers: No pending PB applicability answer blocks separately initiated Analysis within Human conditions; runtime readiness not established
safe_continuation_prerequisites: Stop; later process independently qualifies and validates applicability, scope and actual fresh start

limitations: Endpoint fingerprints cannot exclude transient or same-principal tampering
